content.title: PALENCIA: WHAT TO SEE?: HISTORY OF PALENCIA
content.text: 🔴 See the full text 👉 https://historyofspain.es/en/video/pa... 🔴 SUBSCRIBE to the channel! 👉 CLICK HERE: http://bit.ly/3y2EYHj Discover Palencia, a hidden gem in Castile and León, nestled in the region of Tierra de Campos along the River Carrión. With roots dating back to the Vaccean people and traces of Roman, Visigothic, and Medieval history, Palencia is a city full of heritage and charm. Visit the impressive Gothic Cathedral of San Antolín, known as the “unknown beauty,” the Plaza Mayor, the church of San Miguel, and the Casa del Cordón with its Renaissance facade. Don’t miss the Cristo del Otero, a 21-meter statue that has become the city’s symbol. The province also offers fascinating sites such as Frómista, Carrión de los Condes, and Aguilar de Campoo, with their monasteries, Romanesque churches, and medieval landmarks. Nature lovers can explore the Fuentes Carrionas Nature Reserve, the Covalgua and Las Tuerces parks, and the lagoons of Nava de Fuentes and Boada. Taste the authentic flavors of Palencia — black pudding from Villada, lentils from Tierra de Campos, roast lamb, and traditional desserts like brazo de San Lorenzo and socorritos pastries. 📌 Key moments of the video: 00:06 Introducción 02:02 Cathedral The Unknown Beauty 04:54 Gastronomy 🔴 Discover more videos about Spanish cities► • Cities of Spain: History and Monuments 🇬🇧 ➡️ Subscribe to our channel and activate notifications: / @historyofspain 💻 Discover more on our website: https://historyofspain.es/en/ ► Follow us on our social profiles: ➔ / historyofspain.es ➔ / historyofspain.es ➔ https://pin.it/43aHHNylq
